correctness.rationale: The exact greedy block count is 1 plus linear weak descents. Every nonconstant circle has an ascent and its maximal rotated block count is 1 plus its cyclic weak descents, with constants treated separately. Weighted adjacency trace and Burnside repetition factors give the integer formula; the h=k constant correction follows exactly. Increasing-arc decomposition proves the sharp support and uniqueness except the 2-by-2 boundary. For top defects r<=2<q, violating any boundary descent requires >=q omissions, so the cyclic colored-defect enumeration is bijective and gives all three formulas. Direct enumeration of 11 parameter configurations across 76 lengths and 60 top-layer parameter cases agrees, but is not used as infinite proof.
